card.fact_statement: The Huadanosaurus holotype features unfused vertebral neurocentral sutures, indicating it was a probable immature individual.
card.source_span: Qiu et al. (2025) identified the Huadanosaurus holotype as belonging to a probable immature individual based on the unfused vertebral neurocentral sutures and scarred bone surfaces.

card.fact_statement: The maxillae of the Tameryraptor holotype bore either 12 or 13 teeth.
card.source_span: Based on the number of alveoli (tooth sockets), the maxillae bore either 12 or 13 teeth, a lower count than in Carcharodontosaurus.
